pool.english: I had culture shock when I arrived.
There are many foreigners in Jeddah.
Respect for elders is very important.

pool.arabic: في ألمانيا الإلتزام بالمواعيد شي مقدس.
pool.arabicTashkeel: في ألمانيا الإلتِزام بالمَواعيد شي مُقَدَّس.
pool.transliteration: fi almaanya il-iltizaam bil-mawaa3eed shay mugaddas.

pool.arabic: الأكل كان غريب عليا في الأول.
pool.arabicTashkeel: الأكل كان غَريب عَلَيّا في الأوَّل.
pool.english: The food was strange to me at first.

pool.arabic: اتأقلم بسرعة مع الحياة في جدة.
pool.arabicTashkeel: اِتأقلَم بسُرعة مَعَ الحَياة في جِدّة.
pool.english: He adapted quickly to life in Jeddah.
pool.transliteration: it2aglam b-sur3a ma3a il-7ayaa fi jidda.

pool.english: Many expatriates live in Saudi Arabia.
The difference between the two cultures is big.

pool.arabic: فيه تشابه بين اللهجة الحجازية والمصرية.
pool.arabicTashkeel: فيه تَشابُه بين اللَّهجة الحِجازية والمَصرية.
pool.english: There's a similarity between the Hijazi and Egyptian dialects.
pool.transliteration: feeh tashaabuh bain il-lahja il-7ijaaziyya w-il-masriyya.

pool.english: It's shameful to eat with the left hand.
Learn the customs before you travel.
The foreigner asked me about the coffee.
It's hard to adapt to the heat.
He compares everything with his country.
There's a big similarity between us.
The Islamic greeting is "peace be upon you".

pool.arabic: هوا صريح، وفيه ناس ما يحبوا كدا.
pool.arabicTashkeel: هوّا صَريح، وفيه ناس ما يِحِبّوا كِدا.
pool.english: He's direct, and some people don't like that.
pool.transliteration: huwwa saree7, w-feeh naas ma yi7ibbu kida.

pool.english: Compare the prices before you buy.
The time difference is five hours.
There's a similarity in the food too.
How do you deal with culture shock?
I feel like a foreigner in my own city.
How long did it take you to adapt?

sentences.arabic: لما وصلت جدة كمقيم، جاتني صدمة ثقافية صغيرة.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: لَمّا وَصَلت جِدّة كَمُقيم، جاتني صَدمة ثَقافية صُغَيَّرة.
sentences.english: When I arrived in Jeddah as an expatriate, I had a small culture shock.
sentences.transliteration: lamma wasalt jidda ka-mugeem, jaatni sadma sagaafiyya sughayyara.

sentences.arabic: التحيات كانت طويلة، والإلتزام بالمواعيد كان مختلف.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: التَّحيات كانَت طَويلة، والإلتِزام بالمَواعيد كان مُختَلِف.
sentences.english: The greetings were long, and punctuality was different.
sentences.transliteration: it-ta7iyyaat kaanat taweela, w-il-iltizaam bil-mawaa3eed kaan mukhtalif.

sentences.arabic: تعلمت إن فيه أشيا عيب، زي إنك تمد رجلك في وش أحد.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: تِعَلَّمت إنّ فيه أشيا عيب، زَي إنَّك تِمِد رِجلَك في وِش أحَد.
sentences.english: I learned that some things are shameful, like pointing the soles of your feet at someone.
sentences.transliteration: t3allamt inn feeh ashya 3aib, zay innak timidd rijlak fi wish a7ad.

sentences.arabic: بس مع الوقت اتأقلمت، ولقيت تشابه كبير مع ثقافتي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَس مَعَ الوَقت اِتأقلَمت، ولَقيت تَشابُه كبير مَعَ ثَقافتي.
sentences.english: But with time I adapted, and I found many similarities with my culture.
sentences.transliteration: bas ma3a il-wagt it2aglamt, w-lageet tashaabuh kbeer ma3a sagaafati.

sentences.english: I always compare Jeddah with my city.

sentences.arabic: أكبر فرق الجو، بس إحترام العيلة نفس الشي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: أكبَر فَرق الجَو، بَس إحتِرام العيلة نَفس الشّي.
sentences.english: The biggest difference is the weather, but the respect for family is the same.
sentences.transliteration: akbar farg ij-jaw, bas i7tiraam il-3eela nafs ish-shay.

scenario.situation: The student, a newly arrived expatriate in Jeddah, asks a Jeddawi colleague about local customs before attending a family gathering for the first time.
scenario.studentRole: A new expatriate learning Saudi (Hijazi) Arabic.
scenario.otherRole: The Jeddawi colleague, who explains what is polite and what is shameful.
scenario.goalEnglish: Ask about greetings, punctuality and taboos, describe your own culture, and compare the similarities and differences.
